sentences.s: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."

trunk.主干翻译: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过……

components.原文: that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."
components.中文翻译: 一个国家的GDP衡量的是"除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切"

components.原文: everything except that which makes life worthwhile
components.中文翻译: 除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切
components.说明: measures的宾语，核心为everything except that

components.原文: which makes life worthwhile
components.中文翻译: 使生活有价值的（东西）

sentences.zh: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过，一个国家的GDP衡量的是"除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切"。

sentences.s: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.

trunk.主干翻译: 现在是一个恰逢其时的时刻

components.原文: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result
components.中文翻译: 随着英国投票脱离欧盟，并且GDP因此已被预测将放缓
components.说明: with引导的独立主格结构作背景状语，含两个并列部分

components.原文: to leave the European Union
components.中文翻译: 脱离欧盟

components.原文: GDP already predicted to slow as a result
components.中文翻译: GDP因此已被预测将放缓
components.说明: 与前一独立主格部分并列，由and连接

components.原文: to slow as a result
components.中文翻译: 因此将放缓

components.原文: to assess what he was referring to
components.中文翻译: 去评估他所指的是什么（的时刻）
components.说明: 不定式作timely moment的后置定语

components.原文: what he was referring to
components.中文翻译: 他所指的是什么

sentences.zh: 随着英国投票脱离欧盟，并且GDP也因此被预测将放缓，现在正是评估他当时所指为何的恰当时机。

sentences.s: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.

trunk.主语: The question of GDP and its usefulness
trunk.主干翻译: 关于GDP及其用处的问题一直困扰着政策制定者

components.原文: of GDP and its usefulness
components.中文翻译: 关于GDP及其用处的

components.原文: for over half a century
components.中文翻译: 长达半个多世纪

sentences.zh: 关于GDP及其用处的问题，半个多世纪以来一直困扰着政策制定者。

sentences.s: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.

components.原文: that it is a flawed concept
components.中文翻译: 它是一个有缺陷的概念

sentences.zh: 许多人认为它是一个有缺陷的概念。

sentences.s: It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.

trunk.主干翻译: 它衡量某些事物，又遗漏某些事物

components.原文: that do not matter
components.中文翻译: 无关紧要的（事物）

components.原文: misses things that do
components.中文翻译: 遗漏了那些（重要的）事物

components.原文: that do
components.中文翻译: （确实重要）的（事物）
components.说明: 修饰后一个things，do为do matter的省略代动词

sentences.zh: 它衡量了那些无关紧要的事物，却遗漏了那些真正重要的事物。

sentences.s: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.

trunk.宾语或表语: the envy of the Western world
trunk.主干翻译: 英国的GDP一直是西方世界羡慕的对象

components.原文: By most recent measures
components.中文翻译: 按照最新的衡量标准

components.原文: with record low unemployment and high growth figures
components.中文翻译: 失业率创历史新低、增长数据居高

components.原文: high growth figures
components.中文翻译: 高增长数据

sentences.zh: 按照最新的多数衡量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界羡慕的对象，失业率创历史新低，增长数据也很高。

sentences.s: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?

trunk.主干翻译: 为什么有超过1700万人投票支持脱欧

components.原文: If everything was going so well
components.中文翻译: 如果一切都进展得如此顺利

components.原文: despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects
components.中文翻译: 尽管有关于脱欧可能对其国家经济前景造成何种影响的警告
components.说明: despite短语作让步状语，内含what宾语从句

components.原文: what it could do to their country's economic prospects
components.中文翻译: 脱欧可能对其国家经济前景造成的影响

sentences.zh: 如果一切真的进展得如此顺利，那么为什么有超过1700万人不顾关于脱欧可能给本国经济前景带来何种影响的警告，仍投票支持脱欧呢？

sentences.s: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.

trunk.主干翻译: 最近一项年度研究为这个问题提供了一些启示

components.原文: of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being
components.中文翻译: 关于各国及其将增长转化为福祉的能力的

components.原文: their ability to convert growth into well-being
components.中文翻译: 它们将增长转化为福祉的能力

components.原文: to convert growth into well-being
components.中文翻译: 将增长转化为福祉（的能力）

components.原文: on that question
components.中文翻译: 对那个问题

sentences.zh: 最近一项关于各国及其将经济增长转化为福祉的能力的年度研究，为那个问题提供了一些启示。

sentences.s: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.

trunk.主干翻译: 英国是表现最差者之一

components.原文: measured
components.中文翻译: 被衡量的（163个国家）
components.说明: 过去分词作countries的后置定语

components.原文: Across the 163 countries measured
components.中文翻译: 在被衡量的163个国家中

components.原文: in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens
components.中文翻译: 在确保经济增长转化为对其公民有意义的改善方面
components.说明: in短语说明performers表现差的方面

components.原文: that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens
components.中文翻译: 经济增长转化为对其公民有意义的改善

sentences.zh: 在被衡量的163个国家中，英国在确保经济增长转化为对其公民有意义的改善这方面属于表现最差的国家之一。

sentences.s: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.

trunk.主干翻译: 超过40套不同的标准已被衡量

components.原文: Rather than just focusing on GDP
components.中文翻译: 而不是仅仅关注GDP
components.说明: rather than短语作方式状语，表对比

components.原文: from health, education and civil society engagement
components.中文翻译: 来自健康、教育和公民社会参与的

components.原文: education and civil society engagement
components.中文翻译: 教育和公民社会参与

components.原文: civil society engagement
components.中文翻译: 公民社会参与

components.原文: to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing
components.中文翻译: 以便对各国的表现做出更全面的评估
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，内含how宾语从句

components.原文: how countries are performing
components.中文翻译: 各国的表现如何

sentences.zh: 为了对各国的表现做出更全面的评估，研究衡量的不仅仅是GDP，还有来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等领域的40多套不同标准。

sentences.s: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.

components.原文: While all of these countries face their own challenges
components.中文翻译: 尽管所有这些国家都面临各自的挑战

sentences.zh: 尽管所有这些国家都面临各自的挑战，但其中存在一些共同的主题。

sentences.s: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.

trunk.宾语或表语: a budding economic recovery / to decline
trunk.主干翻译: 出现了一场萌芽中的经济复苏，但主要经济体持续衰退

components.原文: since the 2008 global crash
components.中文翻译: 自2008年全球崩盘以来

components.原文: in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline
components.中文翻译: 但在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上，主要经济体持续衰退

components.原文: to decline
components.中文翻译: 衰退

components.原文: in key indicators in areas such as health and education
components.中文翻译: 在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上

sentences.zh: 是的，自2008年全球崩盘以来出现了萌芽中的经济复苏，但在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上，主要经济体仍持续衰退。

sentences.s: Yet this isn't the case with all countries.

components.原文: with all countries
components.中文翻译: 对所有国家而言

sentences.zh: 然而，并非所有国家都是这种情况。

sentences.s: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.

trunk.主干翻译: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家已看到了巨大的改善

components.原文: across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment
components.中文翻译: 在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的各项指标上

components.原文: income equality and the environment
components.中文翻译: 收入平等和环境
components.说明: civil society、income equality、the environment三者并列

sentences.zh: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家，在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的各项指标上，都取得了巨大的改善。

sentences.s: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.

components.原文: that rich countries can learn
components.中文翻译: 富裕国家能够学到的（教训）

components.原文: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success
components.中文翻译: 当GDP不再被视为衡量一个国家成功的唯一标准时
components.说明: When引导时间状语从句，修饰冒号后分句的looks

sentences.zh: 这是富裕国家可以汲取的一个教训：当GDP不再被视为衡量一个国家成功的唯一标准时，世界看起来就大不相同了。

sentences.s: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.

components.原文: what Kennedy was referring to
components.中文翻译: 肯尼迪所指的

components.原文: that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough
components.中文翻译: 尽管GDP一直是衡量各国经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不再足够

components.原文: while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations
components.中文翻译: 尽管GDP一直是衡量各国经济活动最常用的方法
components.说明: while引导让步状语从句，修饰表语从句内的is

components.原文: as a measure
components.中文翻译: 作为一种衡量标准

sentences.zh: 因此，肯尼迪所指的是：尽管GDP一直是衡量各国经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不再足够。

sentences.s: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes—all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.

components.原文: such as environmental quality or education outcomes
components.中文翻译: 诸如环境质量或教育成果等

components.原文: all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being
components.中文翻译: 所有这些都是有助于一个人幸福感的事物
components.说明: 破折号后作前文factors的同位/补充说明

components.原文: that contribute to a person's sense of well-being
components.中文翻译: 有助于一个人幸福感的（事物）

sentences.zh: 它不包括诸如环境质量或教育成果等重要因素——而所有这些都是有助于一个人幸福感的事物。

sentences.s: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.

trunk.主干翻译: 对增长的猛烈打击可能导致一种下降

components.原文: predicted around the world and in the UK
components.中文翻译: 在全世界和英国都被预测到的（对增长的打击）
components.说明: 过去分词短语作hit的后置定语

components.原文: in the UK
components.中文翻译: 在英国
components.说明: around the world与in the UK由and并列

components.原文: in the everyday services
components.中文翻译: 日常服务方面的（下降）

components.原文: we depend on for our well-being and for growth
components.中文翻译: 我们赖以获得幸福和增长的（日常服务）

sentences.zh: 全世界以及英国都预测到的对增长的猛烈打击，可能导致我们赖以维持幸福和增长的日常服务出现下滑。

sentences.s: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.

trunk.主干翻译: 政策制定者可以避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步

components.原文: who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures
components.中文翻译: 将精力重新聚焦于改善福祉而非仅仅担忧GDP数据的（政策制定者）

components.原文: simply worrying about GDP figures
components.中文翻译: 仅仅担忧GDP数据

components.原文: may even see progress
components.中文翻译: 甚至可能看到进步
components.说明: 由and连接，与could avoid并列作谓语

sentences.zh: 但是，那些将精力重新聚焦于改善福祉、而非仅仅担忧GDP数据的政策制定者，或许能够避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。
